cases.sentence: В те дни филистимляне собрали свои ___ , чтобы воевать с Израилем.
cases.explain: The verb собрали (gathered) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он спрашивал ___, но Господь не отвечал ему.
cases.explain: The verb спрашивал (inquired/asked) is transitive and takes accusative.
The verb найдите (find) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Саул, изменив свою внешность и надев другие одежды, отправился вместе с двумя ___.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Когда женщина увидела Самуила, она громко вскрикнула и сказала ___.
cases.explain: The verb сказала (said) takes the dative case for the person addressed.

cases.sentence: Я вижу ___ , который поднимается из земли.
cases.explain: The verb вижу (see) takes the accusative case.
The verb тревожить (disturb) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Саул тотчас же упал на ___ в ужасе от слов Самуила.
cases.explain: The verb упал (fell) with на (on/to) takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: В те дни филистимляне собрали свои войска, чтобы воевать с Израилем.
reading.question: What were the Philistines preparing to do?
reading.explain: The Philistines gathered their armies in order to fight with Israel.

reading.ru: Саул изгнал из страны вызывателей умерших и чародеев.
reading.question: What had Saul done to those with familiar spirits?
options: Made them commanders in his army
reading.explain: Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and wizards out of the land.

reading.ru: Увидев филистимское войско, Саул испугался, его сердце охватил страх.
reading.question: How did Saul react when he saw the Philistine army?
options: He was afraid and his heart trembled greatly
He assembled his army to fight
He sent messengers to make peace
reading.correct: He was afraid and his heart trembled greatly
reading.explain: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid and his heart trembled greatly.

reading.ru: Он спрашивал Господа, но Господь не отвечал ему, ни в снах, ни через Урим, ни через пророков.
reading.question: How did God respond to Saul inquiries?
options: The Lord did not answer him in any way
The Lord answered through a prophet
The Lord appeared to him in a dream
The Lord spoke through the Urim
reading.correct: The Lord did not answer him in any way
reading.explain: The Lord did not answer Saul by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.

reading.ru: Саул, изменив свою внешность и надев другие одежды, отправился вместе с двумя спутниками и ночью пришел к той женщине.
reading.question: How did Saul disguise himself to visit the medium?
options: He changed his appearance and wore different clothes
He wore royal garments and announced his name
He rode in a chariot with bodyguards
He came alone during the day
reading.correct: He changed his appearance and wore different clothes
reading.explain: Saul disguised himself, put on other clothing, and went with two men by night.

reading.ru: Саул тотчас же упал на землю в ужасе от слов Самуила. Силы оставили его, потому что он ничего не ел весь день и всю ночь.
reading.question: Why was Saul so weakened after hearing Samuel words?
options: He had eaten nothing all day and night
The woman cast a spell on him
He had been running for many days
reading.correct: He had eaten nothing all day and night
reading.explain: Saul fell terrified, and had no strength because he had eaten no bread all day and night.
